propositions: Prompt cache breakpoint placement after pass-specific stance suffix instead of at shared-prefix boundary prevents cross-pass cache hits within a single plan-review run.
Cache writes occur on every gate call (~9.2-9.5k tokens at 1.25x premium per review) but are never read across calls, resulting in pure token waste on single-step passes.
The marked prefix intentionally embeds the full plan text to enable within-run reuse, making cross-ticket prefix identity unsatisfiable without destroying container/chunk fan-out reuse.
Diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective detects write==0 AND read==0 but misses the write>0/read==0 shape, leaving write-every-call-never-read inefficiency invisible to telemetry.

Relocating the cache breakpoint to the end of the byte-stable shared_plan_prefix boundary enables Pass-1 finder writes to be read by Pass-2 verifiers within one run and by same-ticket re-reviews within TTL.

Moving cache_prefix knob to RunRequest allows splitting system_prompt into static prefix (cache-marked) and dynamic instruction suffix (unmarked), preserving model-visible bytes while repositioning the cache boundary.
